description:
Proposal (approved 2026-11-15): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-bitstring-split.html, S1. Supersedes option B of ../fz-sc8.30.html.

Facts (probed on fz-nml.11 31823421d, interp/run/build agree; Elixir 1.19.4 oracle; page section 8a):
- H1: <<0::size(n)>> with n=3 is typed binary: is_binary true, byte_size panics (ir_runtime.rs:1113). Elixir: false, 1.
- H2: <<_::3, rest::binary>> matches <<1,2>>; <<_::8, rest::binary>> matches <<1,2::3>>. Elixir: no match. field_end answers bit_len-pos for Binary and Bits alike (ir_runtime.rs:1506); native BitFieldFits answers 1 for a Rest (native_codegen/prim.rs:881).
- H3: a partial bitstring arriving as any selects a when is_binary / b :: binary clause.
- H4': String.upcase, <> (both sides), :binary.copy on a partial bitstring panic in Rust; Elixir raises.
- Refuted: H4 (all 10 of 130 externs returning binary build whole bytes), H5 (in-place <> never changes an older value; refs 201/201/202 = Elixir).

What changes (atomic: types, value typing and runtime test together, or a clause claims what it does not check):
- BasicBits gains BITSTRING_NO_BINARY; bitstring = BINARY|BITSTRING_NO_BINARY. resolve.rs CONSTRUCTORS gains bitstring; display/canon print the union as bitstring (descr.ex:1245-1249).
- Value typing by alignment as Elixir of.ex:639-680: known sizes summing to a multiple of 8 -> binary, other known -> bitstring and not binary, unknown -> bitstring; literals binary. Sites: jobs/semantic.rs:713, 806, 2818, 2919; dispatch_reachability.rs:392.
- Runtime axis Binaries splits (tag + bit_len%8==0 / !=0) on interp (runtime_type_predicate.rs:1320; dispatch_exec.rs:1032 cursor answers (source bits - position)%8) and native (runtime_test.rs:253, reusing emit_binary_bit_len).
- rest::binary whole-byte test in field_end, and BitFieldFits's Rest arm asks the same question; folded away when the subject is binary and prior fields sum to whole bytes.
- Types::is_binary -> is_bitstring (only caller cursor_shape / layout_from_demand, jobs/transport.rs ~2600).
- Kernel is_bitstring/1; byte_size takes bitstring and rounds up (delete the panic).
- Extern spelling bitstring (from_semantic_type, Any lane: the word passes through); fz_bitstring_valid_utf8, fz_brand_bitstring_as_utf8, fz_bitstring_utf8_prefix, fz_binary_referenced_size change any -> bitstring.
- Docs: set-theoretic-types, dispatch-matrix, pattern-matching, any-value, externs, specs; guides externs (also fix the false 'raises an arg exception' at externs.html:565), pattern-matching.

Acceptance: oracle fixture 01360 (block 01360-01379) covering H1-H3, H4', guards and bodies, byte_size(<<1::3>>)=1, a cursor rest starting between bytes, and fz-sc8.30's two rest::binary non-matches; H4/H5 rows unchanged. Types tests pin display of each bit and their union. 01168 01169 01182 01184 01021 01151 01335 stay green. Pins: each move reported with its mechanism; a rise waits for authorization. Make Distiller Fast's fz-sc8.229/.230 touch layout_from_demand and the dispatch_exec cursor arm: tell them before landing; they rebase.
title: A bitstring is not a binary: two type bits, a whole-byte runtime test, and rest::binary refuses partial bytes, as in Elixir
